home.name: John Gibson
home.news: The Red Wings scored only two goals combined in their first two games (0-2-0), but are coming off their first victory of the season. The 33-year-old Gibson saved 22 of 25 shots (.880 SV%) in the outing and received ample goal support, defeating the Ottawa Senators 5-3. Gibson has a 2.38 GAA and .903 SV% this season (1-2-0).

away.name: Igor Shesterkin
away.news: Shesterkin was named the NHL's opening-week first star after posting a stellar 1.67 GAA and .934 SV% in three games (2-1-0), capping it by scoring his first career goal into an empty net. The 30-year-old Russian goalie has continued his winning ways since, saving 17 of 19 shots (.895 SV%) in the Rangers' previous outing, a 5-2 win over the New York Islanders. The Rangers, riding a league-best four-game winning streak, enter Friday's contest as +129 road underdogs against a 2-1-0 Washington Capitals team.

home.name: Logan Thompson
home.news: Thompson has quietly become one of the NHL's most consistent and reliable goalies over the past several seasons, coming off consecutive 31-win campaigns. The 29-year-old goalie hopes to continue his upward trajectory after an encouraging start to the 2026-27 season, saving 58 of 63 shots (.921 SV%) through his first two games (2-0-0). The Capitals enter Friday's contest as -141 home favourites against a New York Rangers team that has outscored its opposition 16-5 during a four-game winning streak.

away.name: Sergei Murashov
away.news: Sergei Murashov had a decent outing in his season debut, but the Penguins have turned to Arturs Silovs in three of four games. That said, aside from his season-opening shutout, Silovs has struggled between the pipes. The 22-year-old Murashov, who saved 32 of 35 shots (.914 SV%) in a 3-2 loss to the Winnipeg Jets, could earn increased playing time if he can string together several strong outings. The Penguins enter Friday's contest as slight +102 road underdogs against a 1-1-0 Columbus Blue Jackets team that has not played in six days.

home.name: Cam Talbot
home.news: The Blue Jackets have relied solely on Jet Greaves through two games this season (1-1-0), but with a back-to-back looming, the team will turn to Talbot for his first start on Friday against the Pittsburgh Penguins. The 39-year-old Talbot has been reliable in recent years, but is coming off a forgetful season, posting an ugly 3.19 GAA and .883 SV% in 34 appearances (12-9-6) with the Detroit Red Wings. The Blue Jackets enter Friday's contest as -118 home favourites against a Penguins team on a two-game losing streak (0-2-0).
